newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Wheat steady, maize down in slow Budapest futures.
newsitem.headline: Wheat steady, maize down in slow Budapest futures.

text.p: Milling wheat futures prices were mostly steady but maize prices continued to fall on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) in light trade, dealers said on Monday.
"It would probably take one or two more limit-down (400 forints per tonne) falls for buyers to appear on the market," said Sandor Ifju of OTP Broker.
May to November maize futures fell to between 19,000 and 20,100 forints per tonne respectively, but December rose 40 to 20,650 forints.
Milling wheat futures were little changed and were the most traded, accounting for 893 contracts out of a modest grains turnover of 1,355 contracts or 669.7 million forints.
Ifju said milling wheat prices were likely to hover around the current levels or rise slightly over the next few days.
